name: Stock Ticker Update
description: Gets the latest price and day change for a list of tickers and writes a short report with a factual market snapshot. Read-only: no trading and no advice. Inputs: symbols (e.g. AAPL,MSFT,NVDA), source (yahoo = real delayed prices, simulated = made-up prices), report_path.

task.instruction: Write a short, factual market snapshot from the facts and table below. Write exactly 3 sentences: (1) how many symbols rose and how many fell; (2) the biggest rise and the biggest fall with their percentages; (3) any symbol that moved more than 3% in either direction, or say that none did. Use only numbers that appear below. Do not predict, give opinions or give advice. Facts: {{quotes.summary}} {{table.content}}
